data.title: Build a star field from a cited catalog sample
data.summary: A licensed catalog sample with RA, Dec, distance units and a stated epoch. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Astropy coordinates uses declared units and coordinate frames.

prerequisites: An authorized NASA / Astropy / REBOUND → Blender or web environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A licensed catalog sample with RA, Dec, distance units and a stated epoch.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent star catalog workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A licensed catalog sample with RA, Dec, distance units and a stated epoch. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Inspect column units, missing distances and the catalog's coordinate frame/epoch
Use Astropy coordinates to transform only supported positions; retain missing values explicitly
Display points with separate brightness styling and a legend for distance scaling

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned build a star field from a cited catalog sample candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Three reference stars agree with independently checked transformed coordinates
No missing distance is silently replaced by zero
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Apparent brightness, physical luminosity and display size are different quantities.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: A sky-direction sphere is more honest than invented depth when distance is absent.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me build a star field from a cited catalog sample in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A licensed catalog sample with RA, Dec, distance units and a stated epoch. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Three reference stars agree with independently checked transformed coordinates; No missing distance is silently replaced by zero. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
